description: This header file declares the interface for the SSP message bus, including initialization, finalization, and resource management functions.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages the message bus with specified component ID, configuration file, and path.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus with optional user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the message bus, cleaning up resources, with optional user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Performs a check on the message bus status with optional user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the message bus, given a priority and user data.
